Hi Milad, I just discovered an issue with the survey triggering schedule for two of my participants. Although my study (3710) is scheduled to prompt participants 10 times a day, for two of them, I can only see prompts for 9 times a day. I double-checked my triggering logic and it should be 10 times a day, and most people have received 10 prompts who have participated so I'm not sure what the issue could be. Can you please advise? It is important that participants receive 10 prompts a day for our schedule. Thanks,Shreya------
